newsitem.title: USA: Family Bargain names Spatz as CFO.
newsitem.headline: Family Bargain names Spatz as CFO.

text.p: Family Bargain Corp said on Tuesday that it named Jonathan Spatz executive vice president-chief financial officer, replacing Jeffrey Gerstel who resigned from the position earlier this year.
In a statement, Family Bargain said Spatz, 41, holds over 20 years experience in the retail industry. He was most recently chief operating officer and CFO at at Strouds Inc.
Family Bargain operates 162 off-price retail stores selling clothes for men, women, children and household goods.
